acceptance.given: Repair work runs against a repository checkout with a captured pre-repair tracked-membership manifest.

oracle.expected: Post-repair tracked membership is byte-for-byte identical to the pre-repair manifest; any added, removed, renamed, or altered tracked path causes rejection.
forbidden: The comparison is omitted or replaced by an assistant claim.
oracle.observable: A deterministic validator compares pre- and post-repair tracked-membership manifests and passes only on exact equality.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run membership validation with a fixture or working-tree state that adds, removes, renames, or alters a tracked path; validation must reject success.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Capture tracked membership before repair, execute the authorized Toolchain repair, recapture membership, and reject any set or path-identity difference while preserving historical records and append-only evidence.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persistent schema or state migration; rollback restores validator logic while retaining historical manifests and evidence.

slice_hint.state_transition: Pre-repair tracked-membership manifest captured -> repair executes -> post-repair manifest compared -> exact equality passes, drift fails.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A deterministic validation invocation records exact pre/post tracked-membership equality; every membership change produces failure.

acceptance.given: Success evaluation is presented with a case whose Consumer was skipped or has no execution evidence.

oracle.expected: The evaluator returns a non-success verdict and records the skipped-Consumer reason; success is accepted only when valid Consumer execution evidence exists.
forbidden: Success is accepted for a skipped-Consumer case.
Missing Consumer execution evidence is treated as a passing Consumer.
A non-success result is asserted without executing the evaluator.
oracle.observable: The Toolchain evaluator executes a skipped-Consumer case and emits a non-success verdict with an explicit skipped-Consumer diagnostic.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the success evaluator against a deliberately skipped-Consumer fixture and assert a non-success verdict containing the skipped-Consumer diagnostic.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require executed Consumer evidence during success evaluation; a skipped or missing Consumer execution must produce a non-success verdict, and the focused test drives that case through the evaluator invocation.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No schema migration; rollback restores evaluator logic while preserving existing case and evidence formats.

slice_hint.state_transition: Skipped Consumer presented -> evaluator checks execution evidence -> missing or skipped evidence yields non-success with diagnostic.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The deterministic evaluator invocation returns non-success for the skipped-Consumer fixture and includes the explicit rejection reason.
